description: Summary figure: DCAR-1 vs HCAR2/HCAR3 pocket positions, nematode conservation, pocket composition
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches

pos   = ['2.60','2.63','2.64','3.28','3.29','3.32','3.33','3.36','7.36','7.39','7.41','7.43']
hcar2 = ['L83','-','Y87','-','-','L107','A108','R111','F277','L280','-','Y284']
hcar3 = ['V83','Y86','Y87','V103','L104','F107','A108','R111','F277','L280','-','Y284']
dcar1 = ['T94','Y97','V98','I112','E113','F116','I117','F120','L295','C298','R300','F302']
# conservation across 18 nematode sequences (identical / 18) from the alignment table
cons  = {'2.60':12,'2.63':16,'2.64':16,'3.28':12,'3.29':17,'3.32':17,'3.33':15,'3.36':17,
         '7.36':16,'7.39':12,'7.41':18,'7.43':13}
# which HCA positions contact ligand (from the computed contact lists)
contact = {'2.60':1,'2.63':1,'2.64':1,'3.28':1,'3.29':1,'3.32':1,'3.33':1,'3.36':1,'7.36':1,'7.39':1,'7.41':0,'7.43':1}

def cls(r):
    if r=='-': return 'none'
    a=r[0]
    if a in 'RKH': return 'basic'
    if a in 'DE': return 'acidic'
    if a in 'FWY': return 'aromatic'
    if a in 'STNQC': return 'polar'
    return 'apolar'
col={'basic':'#c0392b','acidic':'#2471a3','aromatic':'#8e44ad','polar':'#16a085','apolar':'#bdc3c7','none':'#ffffff'}

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(14,8.5))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,2, height_ratios=[1.25,1], width_ratios=[1.6,1], hspace=0.38, wspace=0.28)

# Panel A: residue identity grid
axA=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,:])
rowsd=[('HCAR2 (human)',hcar2),('HCAR3 (human)',hcar3),('DCAR-1 (C. elegans)',dcar1)]
for yi,(name,vals) in enumerate(rowsd):
    for xi,(p,v) in enumerate(zip(pos,vals)):
        axA.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((xi,-yi),1,1, facecolor=col[cls(v)], edgecolor='white', lw=2, alpha=0.85))
        axA.text(xi+0.5,-yi+0.5,v,ha='center',va='center',fontsize=11,color='white' if cls(v)!='apolar' and cls(v)!='none' else 'black',fontweight='bold')
axA.set_xlim(0,len(pos)); axA.set_ylim(-3,1.6)
axA.set_xticks(np.arange(len(pos))+0.5); axA.set_xticklabels(pos, fontsize=11)
axA.set_yticks([0.5,-0.5,-1.5]); axA.set_yticklabels([r[0] for r in rowsd], fontsize=11)
for xi,p in enumerate(pos):
    if contact[p]: axA.text(xi+0.5,1.15,'ligand\ncontact',ha='center',va='center',fontsize=7,color='#444')
axA.set_title('A  Orthosteric-pocket positions (Ballesteros-Weinstein) in HCAR2/HCAR3 vs DCAR-1\n'
              'HCA contacts computed from 8IJA (niacin) and 9JKT (D-phenyllactate); DCAR-1 numbering from GPCRdb assignment on AF-G5EDI0',
              fontsize=11.5, loc='left')
axA.set_xlabel('Ballesteros-Weinstein position')
for s in axA.spines.values(): s.set_visible(False)
axA.tick_params(length=0)
handles=[mpatches.Patch(color=col[k],label=k) for k in ['basic','acidic','aromatic','polar','apolar']]
axA.legend(handles=handles, ncol=5, loc='lower left', bbox_to_anchor=(0,-0.42), frameon=False, fontsize=9)

# Panel B: conservation across nematode orthologs
axB=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
vals=[cons[p] for p in pos]
bars=axB.bar(range(len(pos)), vals, color=[col[cls(d)] for d in dcar1], edgecolor='k', lw=0.5)
axB.axhline(18, ls='--', c='grey', lw=1)
axB.set_xticks(range(len(pos))); axB.set_xticklabels([f"{p}\n{d}" for p,d in zip(pos,dcar1)], fontsize=8.5)
axB.set_ylabel('sequences identical to\nC. elegans residue (of 18)')
axB.set_ylim(0,19.5)
axB.set_title('B  Conservation in 18 nematode DCAR-1 homologues (UniRef50_G5EDI0)', fontsize=11, loc='left')
for i,v in enumerate(vals): axB.text(i, v+0.3, str(v), ha='center', fontsize=8)

# Panel C: pocket composition
axC=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
labels=['aromatic\nF/W/Y','basic\nR/K/H','acidic\nD/E','polar\nS/T/N/Q/C','apolar']
h3=dict(zip(['V83','Y86','Y87','W93','V103','L104','F105','F107','A108','R111','C177','I178','S179','F180','H189','F277','L280','Y284'],range(18)))
def comp(res):
    a=[r[0] for r in res]
    return [sum(x in 'FWY' for x in a), sum(x in 'RKH' for x in a), sum(x in 'DE' for x in a),
            sum(x in 'STNQC' for x in a), sum(x in 'AVLIMPG' for x in a)]
h3res=list(h3.keys())
d1res=['Y38','M42','T87','S90','T94','Y97','V98','V109','E113','F116','V168','T171','Y199','R202','Y269','W272','C273','Y289','M293','L296','R300','L303']
w=0.38; x=np.arange(5)
axC.bar(x-w/2, comp(h3res), w, label=f'HCAR3 orthosteric pocket (n={len(h3res)}, 75 $\\AA^3$)', color='#2471a3')
axC.bar(x+w/2, comp(d1res), w, label=f'DCAR-1 EC-half cavity (n={len(d1res)}, 88 $\\AA^3$)', color='#c0392b')
axC.set_xticks(x); axC.set_xticklabels(labels, fontsize=8.5); axC.set_ylabel('lining residues')
axC.legend(fontsize=8, frameon=False)
axC.set_title('C  Chemical composition of the detected pockets', fontsize=11, loc='left')
plt.show()
